items.title: How Amadeus Pulled Away From Sabre and Travelport
items.why: Shifts in distribution share affect which booking platforms premium card travel portals can plug into.
items.summary_ai: Amadeus has gained distribution share and grown its airline IT business, while Sabre and Travelport remain burdened by debt.
items.take: Shifts in distribution share affect which booking platforms premium card travel portals can plug into.

items.title: Sabre Wants to Be the Transaction Engine Behind AI Travel Bookings
items.why: Agentic booking flows could change where card rewards get earned, so open a conversation with Sabre early.
items.summary_ai: Sabre is positioning its booking infrastructure as the transaction layer behind AI-driven travel purchases.
items.take: Agentic booking flows could change where card rewards get earned, so open a conversation with Sabre early.
